text: MessageList.addMessage skips IMAPDeleted/Expunged by default. New-mail, moved, copied and deleted event listeners instead pass includeDeletedMessages:true and convert the event messages before background wakeup. Entry 1803 also stops stripping deleted bits from CachedMsgHeader and removes this filter from generic conversion. Preserve the difference between current list visibility and an event’s historical payload. No intermittent event loss was reproduced. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Filter deleted messages in live lists without erasing historical event data
